Guidelines

House Rules

🤫
Quiet Hours 10 PM – 9 AM. Please respect our neighbours. Disruptive noise after a warning is strictly prohibited.
📷
Security Cameras. Exterior cameras at entrances. Tampering with, covering, or disconnecting cameras is strictly prohibited.
🚭
No Smoking or Vaping inside the home, garage, or within 10 ft of doors or windows. Evidence of indoor smoking incurs a minimum $250 remediation fee.
🚫
No Parties or Events. Only registered guests are permitted. Exceeding the guest count is strictly prohibited.
🐾
Quick Pet Rule. Pets are strictly not allowed on furniture or beds, must never be left unattended, and all yard waste must be cleaned up immediately.
🔊
Multi-Unit Notice. This is a basement suite in a home where the owners live upstairs. Your space is fully private, with your own entrance, but you may occasionally hear light household sounds from the levels above.
⚠️
Enforcement. Continued non-compliance may result in your stay being cut short.
Waste & Recycling

Garbage Guide

🗑️ Garbage & Recycling
🗑️
Garbage
Place all garbage in the city bins located on the patio.
♻️
Recycling & Cardboard
Please place all recyclables in blue recycling bags. Leave blue bags and broken-down cardboard beside the city bins on the patio — our crew will handle the rest.
📅
Collection Day
Waste is collected by a private company every Tuesday. Please do not place bins on the street — our crew handles the rest.
🐾
Pet Waste
Pick up all pet waste and dispose in regular garbage bags before checkout.

Departure

Checkout Checklist

2
Wash and put away any dishes used
3

4

5
Garbage: place all waste in the city bins on the patio
6
Lock all doors and windows before leaving
